gopīcand.hi: गोपीचन्द, राजकुमार जो संसार छोड़कर योगी बने; भर्तृहरिके साथ जिन्हें गोरखनाथजीने तारा
gopīcand.en: Gopīcand, a prince who gave up the world for the ascetic's life; with Bhartṛhari, one whom Gorakhnāth saved

nātha.en: the Nāthas, the order of yogīs of Gorakhnāth

रसों.en: tastes, relishes; the pleasures of the senses
